column15: bit 0 = Hardware problem; bit 1 = Calibration in progress; bit 2 = Memory test finished; bit 3 = In diagnostic mode; bit 4 = Warning; bit 5 = Resistance values logged; bit 6 = Resistance test in progress; bit 7 = Discharge report logged; bit 8 = Discharge in progress; bit 9 = Discharge disabled; bit 10 = Historical alarm logged; bit 11 = DCM communication error; bit 12 = Logging discharge data; bit 13 = Maintenance alarm happened; bit 14 = Critical alarm happened; bit 15 = Alarm disabled

0 = Start resistance test; 1 = Stop resistance test; 2 = Start firmware scan; 3 = Stop firmware scan; 5 = Load off; 6 = Start diagnostics; 7 = Stop diagnostics; 8 = Reset alarm; 10 = Start load test; 11 = Stop load test; 12 = Start EEPROM test; 16 = Enable alarm; 17 = Disable alarm; 18 = Close alarm contact; 19 = Open alarm contact; 20 = Close charger contact; 21 = Open charger contact
